phase: Isolated norm-free same-coarse/DST tolerance-converged right-GMRES baseline
scope: Classical finite five-point constant-spacing Dirichlet K with real positive squared slowness m and arbitrary finite real diagonal damping d. No certificate/convergence theorem or generic PML/backend claim.
source_access: Only staged new files changed. Synthetic tests import frozen public reference classes for independent parity. No project NPZ, checkpoints, calibration, validation, test or confirmation arrays read/evaluated.

api.factory: CoarseDSTEngine(shape,spacing,damping,rank,model_cache_size=4,context_cache_size=8); optional from_helmholtz snapshots current declared configuration.
api.prepare: factory.prepare(model,frequency_hz)->CoarseDSTContext; bounded content caches immutable m moments and per-model/frequency LU.
api.core: context.apply_operator, project, lift, solve_coarse, high_inverse, apply_preconditioner accept vector or n×k columns (appropriate rank rows for coarse operations).
api.report: context.solve_report(rhs,adjoint=False,x0=None,rtol=1e-10,atol=1e-12,maxiter=None,restart=None) returns solution+per-column convergence diagnostics and actual query-cost delta.
api.solve: context.solve(rhs,adjoint=False,...) returns ndarray ONLY if every column meets true residual; otherwise raises LinearSolveFailure carrying full result. No LU fallback is silently performed. PreparationUnavailable is explicit for unrepresentable/failed setup.
api.default_maxiter: n total Arnoldi iterations per column; restart=None means bounded restart=min(n,50), so Krylov storage is O(n*min(n,50)). Explicit restart=n requests unrestarted GMRES when storage permits. A smaller declared restart or different cap is recorded; maxiter0 remains a bounded no-update query.

algebra.basis: First rank real tensor Dirichlet sine modes sorted (eigenvalue,z,x), identical ordering to current stability foundation; orthonormal DST-I project/lift.
algebra.galerkin: One DCT-I of damping at engine construction; one DCT-I of m per content miss, exact product-of-sines grid moment identity for Ar=BᵀAB; one reduced LU per uncached(m,freq), shared forward/adjoint RHS.
algebra.excluded_certificate_work: No m²/d² moments, coupling Gram, PSD shift, inverse matrix columns, norm bounds, SVD/eigenproblems, gamma/tau tests or derivative-bound evaluation.
algebra.high_inverse: H=Q DST^-1 diag(1/(lambda−omega²*m_mid+i*omega*d_mid)) DST Q, where both midpoints are half-min+half-max; low spectral slots masked zero. No positive-high-coercivity condition is needed by GMRES; a zero/nonfinite high denominator fails setup.
algebra.preconditioner: M r=H r+B Ar^-1 Bᵀ(r−A H r). Adjoint action N uses Aᴴ, Ar^-H, conjugated high denominator. N is generally NOT Mᴴ because correction ordering differs.
algebra.right_gmres: Arnoldi applies A M to basis vectors and reconstructs x=x0+M V y using stored preconditioned directions; two-pass modified Gram-Schmidt and complex Givens QR, no projected least-squares SVD. Columns solved independently; honest baseline, no block/recycling acceleration claim.
algebra.true_stop: An estimate triggers a candidate check. Explicit ||b−A x||2<=max(atol,rtol*||b||2) is the sole convergence criterion. Initial warm starts also checked. Happy breakdown, cap/restart, invalid arithmetic and tiny unreachable tolerance never bypass it.
algebra.gradient_scope: Generic complex q columns and arbitrary complex rectangular P are supported by the linear solves. Tests verify physical g=omega² Re sum(conj(lambda)*u), lambda=A^-H Pᴴ(Pu−d), including repeated point receivers. The core does not perform or count receiver/gradient algebra; the owning oracle must charge that work.
algebra.unrestarted_dominance_scope: The exact-arithmetic same-preconditioner GMRES residual-minimization comparison with k Richardson sweeps holds for an unrestarted search (explicit restart=n) or a common initial cycle. It is not a dominance theorem across restarted cycles. The public resource-safe default is restart=min(n,50).

identity_and_immutability: Array snapshots are independent, readonly copies; public config properties have no setter; public model/operator identities are copies. SHA256 binds canonical little-endian m,d,basis/eigenvalues/Ar/frequency plus operator config. The solver snapshots RHS/warm starts and records their hashes. This is provenance, not cryptographic protection against malicious modification of Python private attributes.

cost_units.setup: basis_setups; computed Laplacian eigenvalue entries; real2D DCT-I transforms; moment matrices; model/context cache hits; reduced operator assemblies; reduced LU factorization attempts; high-denominator builds.
cost_units.transforms: dispatches count actual scipy FFT calls. real_column_transforms counts logical real2D transforms: two per complex column, one per real column. Generic public field inputs are canonicalized complex128, so normally two. This is not a FLOP count.
cost_units.linear_algebra: Coarse solve dispatches separate from actual forward/adjoint RHS columns. No reduced inverse matrix is formed.
cost_units.stencil: operator_dispatches separate from logical columns, with forward/adjoint split. Each inverse action pays A H r and each Arnoldi step pays A M v; true residual checks pay actual full operator application.
cost_units.krylov: Per-column solve count; Arnoldi iterations, all Gram-Schmidt dot/AXPY updates, vector norm evaluations (field named arnoldi_norm_evaluations also includes rhs/true-residual norms), Givens construction/rotation, projected triangular solve, solution-update columns and restart cycles. Counters are work categories, not complete floating-operation counts or wall-time equivalents.
cost_units.fine_and_certificate: Fine factorization/direct-RHS and certificate SVD/eig/inverse counters stay zero. A consumer’s explicit fallback must charge its own fine work and preserve the failure report.
cost_units.ledger: Factory/context snapshots are shared cumulative engine counts. solve_report.costs includes solve query delta only; constructor+prepare costs MUST be included by the owner’s before/after snapshot and not counted twice from static provenance. Cache reuse is content safe and must be allowed equally for exact controls.

optional_paired_2N_design_only.inverse_action: T=[[M,0],[N W M,N]], matching u+=M ru followed by lambda+=N(rlambda+W*delta_u), with updated-state RHS.
optional_paired_2N_design_only.reason_to_defer: Root approved generic core first. Independent solves to tolerance are sufficient for the current strong exact control. Optional paired norm scaling, source handling and cost accounting need a separate frozen design before adding scope.

validation.tests: 15 passed -Werror in0.56s; repo-config Ruff passed. Added n72 actual allocation guard for defaultrestart50, explicit72 override, true-residual checks, iteration-limit and unattainable-tolerance failure statuses.
coverage: Independent sparse-Kronecker LU on a non-square grid, arbitrary complex multi-RHS and both adjoints
Analytical sine Galerkin equality and same inverse action as existing coarse correction
No certificate SVD/eig; ONE damping/model DCT and shared forward/adjoint LU; cache/content identity
Scalar/matrix shape and exact initial warm start/zero RHS
Arbitrary complex rectangular P and repeated point receiver multi-source physical-gradient finite differences
Same-inverse fixed-work GMRES residual vs unit Richardson
Iteration cap, restarted convergence and tiny-tolerance true-residual-floor rejection
Nonfinite internal action/overflow report and strict JSON; invalid real/model/frequency/shape checks
Actual matrix transform/solve dispatch vs RHS-column counts and GMRES stencil-work invariant
validation.not_run: No project outcomes, PDE benchmark/timings, training or original experiment replay.

status: Ready for independent read-only review; no main source mutation, commit, push or actual project evaluation authorized/performed by this staging implementation.
nominal_operator_scope: from_helmholtz reconstructs declared configuration only, ignoring patched actual stiffness/damping/operator methods. The consuming oracle must independently bind actual queried A to this nominal operator.
merit_semantics: Tolerance-converged fields and derived merits/gradients are approximations, not mathematically exact arithmetic. Integration must preserve backend/tolerances/diagnostics/costs and common paid-reference acceptance.
